overall_reason: Vercel's Geist tokens and Tailwind carry a deliberately small page: three text colours, two fills, two radii and type 99% on token values; the one drift is code text at 13, 13.5 and 14px.

score.reason: T-VALUE-INVENTORY, T-SCALE-FIT and T-TOKEN-TIERS pass; T-DRIFT-PAIRS finds three code sizes (TOK-010).

findings.evidence: Code renders at three sizes: inline code chips such as ':focus-visible' are 13.5px (89 elements), code inside links 14px (9) and the code block 13px (1) (values.1440.font_size near_duplicates 13/13.5 and 13.5/14).
findings.after: One code size token, for example 13px, for chips, linked code and blocks
findings.why: Linked and plain code chips side by side differ by half a pixel, which reads as two components.

findings.evidence: The shared stylesheet carries 228 arbitrary-value selectors (text-[11px]/[20px], text-[12px]/[24px], rounded-l-[5px], rounded-r-[6px], duration-[400ms]) and 57 bracketed font sizes beside the Geist text tokens (declarations.by_family.font_size arbitrary_utility); this page renders none of them visibly.
findings.before: Bracketed sizes and radii beside the Geist scale
findings.after: Map the needed steps onto Geist tokens (text-copy-13, --geist-radius) and drop the brackets
findings.why: The page holds, but the sheet it ships with invites one-offs on the next page.

strengths: Text uses three colours (#ededed, #a1a1a1, white) and fills two (#1a1a1a, #0a0a0a).
Shadows are 96% token references; durations sit on 150 and 200ms tokens.
not_investigated: inline style attributes: the DOM records computed styles only
token source files behind the shipped CSS (Sass, JSON tokens, Figma variables): only the shipped CSS was read
states the capture did not open (hover, focus, open menus): their values are not in the table
the light theme as rendered: the capture shows dark; the dark class sets 294 tokens and the table reads the Geist colour scale (--ds-*) as dark-only, so parity could not be settled
T-SYSTEM-DRIFT: no Geist token file supplied
